page_title: RMA 1-2 VAL | Real Madrid v Valencia 05/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+8' It's like he was asking for a caution. Cristhian Mosquera (Valencia) receives a yellow card.

90+7' Antonio Rudiger (Real Madrid) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads inside the left post, but Giorgi Mamardashvili shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
90+5' Maximillian Aarons (Valencia) gets a yellow card, off the field.
90+5' 1 - 2 Goal! Rafa Mir plays a neat lofted pass into the box for Hugo Duro (Valencia), who beats the defender in the air and plants a header into the roof of the net from close range. 1:2.
90+4' The referee allows time for a substitution. Enzo Barrenechea will be replaced by Hugo Guillamon (Valencia).
90+3' Rafa Mir (Valencia) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
90+2' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
90+2' Fran Perez (Valencia) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Antonio Rudiger (Real Madrid) gets his head on the corner, but he can't find the target as his header flies high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Valencia will have a goal kick.
90' Real Madrid force a corner. They send men into the box.
90' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
88' Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle and it's Endrick (Real Madrid) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
87' The resulting set piece from Valencia is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
85' Lucas Vazquez goes off the pitch and Arda Guler (Real Madrid) comes on.
81' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 17:8.
78' He should have scored! Endrick (Real Madrid) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block.
77' Carlo Ancelotti decides to make a substitution. Fran Garcia will be replaced by Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid).
77' Vinicius Junior will be replaced by David Alaba (Real Madrid).
77' Carlo Ancelotti prepares a substitution. Luka Modric is replaced by Endrick (Real Madrid).
76' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) strikes the ball towards goal from the middle of the penalty area, but his shot goes straight into the gloves of the goalkeeper.
74' That will be all from Maximillian Aarons who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Hugo Duro (Valencia).
74' It is time for a substitution. Fran Perez (Valencia) is on for Andre Almeida.
74' Carlos Corberan has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Pepelu (Valencia) replacing Javi Guerra.

71' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot in the direction of the right post. Giorgi Mamardashvili is alert and denies him with a nice save.
70' Real Madrid take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

68' What a miss! Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) is left standing right in front of goal with only the keeper to beat after a clever pass, but he somehow contrives to toe poke the ball just past the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Valencia.
66' Andre Almeida (Valencia) fails to deliver a decent cross from the corner and the ball goes out of play.

65' Fran pulls off a fantastic save! Mouctar Diakhaby (Valencia) attempts to head home after a precise cross into the box. He aims his header low towards the right post, but the effort is kept out. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Valencia will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

62' A cross is whipped in towards Rodrygo (Real Madrid) on the edge of the six-yard box. He wins the ball but sends his header just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Valencia.
61' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players.
59' Carlos Corberan has decided to substitute Umar Sadiq and he is replaced by Rafa Mir (Valencia).
58' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
57' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Rodrygo (Real Madrid) will replace Brahim Diaz.

52' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) runs with the ball towards the keeper and pulls the trigger from close range, but Giorgi Mamardashvili anticipates his intention and makes an amazing save to stop the shot going into the bottom right corner.

50' 1 - 1 Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) scores from the resulting corner. The ball slips through the box to Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) and he smashes it into the top right corner, giving the goalkeeper no chance.
49' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) is about to take a corner kick.
47' Looks like Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
46' Guillermo Cuadra shows a yellow card to Umar Sadiq (Valencia) for his blatant foul.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' The end of the first half.

45+3' A short pass finds Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid). He spots the keeper off his line and shoots from mid-range, but the ball sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Valencia will have a goal kick.
45+1' The resulting corner, taken by Luka Modric (Real Madrid), comes to nothing.
45+1' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. Real Madrid force their opponents to concede a corner.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
45' Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle. Umar Sadiq (Valencia) commits a foul after dangerous play. A free kick has been awarded to Real Madrid.
44' Fran (Real Madrid) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Giorgi Mamardashvili intercepts the ball.
44' A pass by Maximillian Aarons (Valencia) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Real Madrid.

42' The opposition back off Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) and he lashes in a shot from the edge of the box that just flies a whisker wide of the right post. Unlucky! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Valencia.
41' Referee Guillermo Cuadra sees the trip by Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
39' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) is adjudged offside.
38' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
37' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
37' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) will deliver the corner kick.

36' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Giorgi Mamardashvili makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the top right corner. The ball goes behind for a corner. Real Madrid will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
35' Umar Sadiq (Valencia) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
35' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Luka Modric (Real Madrid). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.

35' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away. The ball goes out of play and Real Madrid have been awarded a corner kick.
33' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) is caught offside!
31' The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 2:1.
28' Real Madrid work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
28' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
27' Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.

24' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Jesus Vazquez (Valencia) inside the box following a slide rule pass. Valencia will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
22' Carlo Ancelotti appears to have said too much and referee Guillermo Cuadra comes over and theatrically shows him a yellow card.
22' Celebrations are cut short for Real Madrid as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was offside!
22' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible offside. The Real Madrid players aren’t happy.
22' An unfortunate own goal is conceded by Mouctar Diakhaby (Valencia), who attempted to block the ball after a cross, but instead he sends it inside the bottom left corner of his own goal.
21' Guillermo Cuadra couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Umar Sadiq (Valencia) and blew his whistle.
18' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

15' 0 - 1 Goal! The ball is swung into the box from the resulting corner kick and finds Mouctar Diakhaby (Valencia), who jumps highest and tries his luck with a header from around the penalty spot. His effort is both strong and precise enough to go inside the right post. The score changes to 0:1.
14' Andre Almeida (Valencia) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.

13' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) places the ball on the penalty spot and sends it towards the right post. His effort isn't powerful enough, allowing Giorgi Mamardashvili to dive and keep the ball out with an excellent save.
13' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
12' Referee Guillermo Cuadra is happy with his original decision after the VAR review. It’s a PENALTY to Real Madrid!
11' Hang on! It might not be a penalty for Real Madrid as the ref now wants to review using VAR. This hopefully won't take too long.
11' Dangerous play by Cesar Tarrega (Valencia). Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle for a foul. The referee uncompromisingly points to the spot and it's a penalty to Real Madrid.
10' Guillermo Cuadra shows a yellow card to Cesar Tarrega (Valencia), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
9' Cesar Tarrega (Valencia) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Guillermo Cuadra blows for a foul.
7' Flag goes up against Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
6' Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
4' Fran Garcia (Real Madrid) commits a rough foul. Guillermo Cuadra stops the game and makes a call.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Chance! Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) was in a good position inside the box, but he couldn't connect with the pass as it was overhit.
Valencia will kick-off.
Guillermo Cuadra will supervise the game today.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
Show lineups
